title: OfficeTown: Generative Organizations for Evolving Agent Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2610.23194v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents increasingly use files and software tools to produce professional deliverables. Such work draws on materials, decisions, and feedback accumulated across assignments. We introduce OfficeTown, a generative simulation framework for professional organizations in which tasks and their context arise from continuing organizational work. From a natural-language description of an organization's purpose and activities, OfficeTown initializes an organization whose members coordinate work, delegate bounded assignments to assistant agents, and review their deliverables. Artifacts, decisions, and unresolved matters persist and shape subsequent work, while responsibilities and permissions determine what each member can see and do. We curate work requests, their context, and review feedback into executable resources for evaluation and learning. translated_title: OfficeTown：面向智能体智能持续进化的生成式组织
translated_abstract: AI 智能体越来越多地使用文件和软件工具来产出专业交付成果，这类工作依赖于跨任务积累的材料、决策与反馈。我们提出 OfficeTown，一个面向专业组织的生成式仿真框架，其中任务及其上下文源于持续进行的组织工作。仅需对组织目的与活动的自然语言描述，OfficeTown 即可初始化一个组织，其成员相互协调工作、将有边界的任务委托给助手智能体，并审查其交付成果。工件、决策和未决事项会持续存在并塑造后续工作，而职责与权限决定了每个成员能够看到和执行的内容。我们将工作请求、其上下文以及审查反馈整理为可用于评估与学习的可执行资源。我们构建了 OfficeTown Bench，包含来自 23 个模拟组织的 406 个任务和 4,836 条评估标准（原文摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 提出 OfficeTown——一个能从自然语言描述生成持续运作的专业组织仿真框架，其中任务、工件、决策与权限随组织工作不断演化，并据此构建了包含 406 个任务和 4,836 条评估标准的 OfficeTown Bench，用于智能体的评估与学习。
en_tdlr: OfficeTown is a generative simulation framework that creates continuously operating professional organizations—in which tasks, artifacts, decisions, and permissions evolve through ongoing work—yielding OfficeTown Bench with 406 tasks and 4,836 evaluation criteria for evaluating and training AI agents.
